mapper.sql: c.eco_id, c.eco_no, array_to_string(c.m4_types, ',') as m4_text, c.before_desc, c.after_desc, c.updated_at, c.updated_by, (select count(*) from qms_change_char x where x.eco_id = c.eco_id) as char_cnt

where.if: and (c.eco_no ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or c.before_desc ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\' or c.after_desc ilike #{keywordLike} escape '\')

mapper.select:
select from qms_change c
order by c.updated_at desc, c.eco_id desc limit #{limit}

select from qms_change c
order by
c.eco_no c.updated_at
desc,
c.eco_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}

select eco_id, eco_no, array_to_string(m4_types, ',') as m4_text, before_desc, after_desc, reason_desc, impact_desc, revert_cond, row_ver, updated_at, updated_by from qms_change where eco_id = #{ecoId}

select x.line_no, case when x.char_id is not null then 'CHAR' else 'PLAN' end as ref_type, x.char_id, x.insp_plan_id, x.impact_desc, case when x.char_id is not null then coalesce(i.item_cd, p.proc_cd) || '-' || ch.char_no else coalesce(pi.item_cd, pk.class_cd, pp.proc_cd) || ' ' || pl.insp_type || ' ' || pl.rev end as ref_label, case when x.char_id is not null then ch.char_nm else pl.status end as ref_nm from qms_change_char x left join qms_char ch on ch.char_id = x.char_id left join mst_item i on i.item_id = ch.item_id left join mst_proc p on p.proc_id = ch.proc_id left join qms_insp_plan pl on pl.insp_plan_id = x.insp_plan_id left join mst_item pi on pi.item_id = pl.item_id left join mst_item_class pk on pk.class_id = pl.item_class_id left join mst_proc pp on pp.proc_id = pl.proc_id where x.eco_id = #{ecoId} order by x.line_no
select status from plm_eco where eco_id = #{ecoId} for share

select 'CHAR' as ref_type, ch.char_id as ref_id, coalesce(i.item_cd, p.proc_cd) || '-' || ch.char_no as ref_label, ch.char_nm as ref_nm from qms_char ch left join mst_item i on i.item_id = ch.item_id left join mst_proc p on p.proc_id = ch.proc_id where ch.use_yn = 'Y' and (ch.item_id in #{x}false or (ch.item_id is null and ch.proc_id in #{x})false) order by ref_label limit 500

select 'PLAN' as ref_type, pl.insp_plan_id as ref_id, coalesce(pi.item_cd, pk.class_cd, pp.proc_cd) || ' ' || pl.insp_type || ' ' || pl.rev as ref_label, pl.status as ref_nm from qms_insp_plan pl left join mst_item pi on pi.item_id = pl.item_id left join mst_item_class pk on pk.class_id = pl.item_class_id left join mst_proc pp on pp.proc_id = pl.proc_id where pl.status in ('DRAFT', 'RELEASED') and ((pl.item_id in #{x} or pl.item_class_id in (select m.item_class_id from mst_item m where m.item_id in #{x}))false or pl.proc_id in #{x}false) order by ref_label limit 500
select char_id from qms_char where char_id = #{id}
select insp_plan_id from qms_insp_plan where insp_plan_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into qms_change (eco_id, comp_cd, eco_no, m4_types, before_desc, after_desc, reason_desc, impact_desc, revert_cond, created_by, updated_by) values (#{ecoId}, hb_current_comp(), '-', #{f.m4Types, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::varchar(10)[], #{f.beforeDesc}, #{f.afterDesc}, #{f.reasonDesc}, #{f.impactDesc}, #{f.revertCond}, #{by}, #{by})

insert into qms_change_char (comp_cd, eco_id, line_no, char_id, insp_plan_id, impact_desc, created_by) values
(hb_current_comp(), #{ecoId}, #{r.lineNo}, #{r.charId}, #{r.inspPlanId}, #{r.impactDesc}, #{by})
mapper.delete: delete from qms_change where eco_id = #{ecoId} and row_ver = #{rowVer}
mapper.select: select exists (select 1 from qms_change where eco_id = #{ecoId})
select count(*) from qms_change_char where eco_id = #{ecoId}
